 RELEASES   mesimon > kanban-tui

 3 releases ∙ newest first ∙ this is v0.9.0-alpha.3

           v0.9.0-alpha.3  ∙  4 Sep 2026                                                           this build

            • The board reads its own release notes. The Esc menu's Release notes row opens the changelog the
              binary was built with, newest first, one band per release, with this build on the entry you are
              running.

            • A card's age is time in column. It was the newest session state change, which reset on every
              hook — so a ticket that had sat in review for a week read 2m after a single prompt.

            • Smaller. n N step between releases; { } page; a long entry keeps its band pinned while its notes
              scroll under it.


           v0.9.0-alpha.2  ∙  2 Sep 2026

            • Shift+Enter asks the agent from the board. On a ticket with a live claude pane it opens a
              one-line field under the card; Enter sends and stays.

            • Paths in a shell pane keep their shape:

                mesimon exec --env <file> -- claude --settings <hooks>

            and the pid stays the agent's.
